description:
Outcome: A member cancels their own booking up to two hours before it starts, from README first version.
Scope: Ownership and cutoff checks; remove booking and release slot/member allowance using the same atomic transaction rules as T-005 and T-006. Excludes: cancelling another member booking, staff override and payments.
Acceptance: Cancellation exactly two hours before start is allowed; later refused; other members bookings unchanged; successful cancellation releases both court slot and member allowance.
Behaviour: Safe idempotent repeated cancellation without disclosure, no false success after failed writes, safe simultaneous cancellation/booking.
Verification: Ownership tests, controlled-clock boundary tests, repeated requests and concurrent cancel/book tests. Prerequisites: T-006. Assumptions: deletion allowed; no audit retention requirement was stated; cutoff equality is inclusive.
title: Owner-authorized cancellation and released capacity
